UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a patient's profile, storing core demographic and health information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

email.description: The user's primary email address, typically obtained from a login provider like Google.

gender.description: The user's gender, used for conditional display of modules (e.g., cycle intelligence).

bloodType.description: The user's blood type (e.g., A+, O-).

allergies.description: A list of known allergies for the user.

languagePreference.description: The preferred language for the user interface and communications.

lastDialogueResponse.description: The user's last response to a dialogue moment (shifts Nitya's tone for 3 days).

lastDialogueResponseDate.description: The timestamp when the user last responded to a dialogue moment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

MedicalRecord.title: MedicalRecord
MedicalRecord.description: Represents an aggregated medical record entry from various sources for a patient.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MedicalRecord entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this medical record belongs to. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N MedicalRecord)

recordType.description: The type of medical record (e.g., 'Lab Result', 'Diagnosis', 'Medication', 'Procedure', 'VisitNote').

source.description: The source system or institution from which the record was obtained (e.g., 'Hospital A', 'Lab B').

recordDate.description: The date when the medical record event occurred or was recorded.

title.description: A brief title or summary for the medical record.

description.description: Detailed description or content of the medical record.

documentUri.description: Optional URI to an external document or report related to this record.

tags.description: Keywords or categories to help organize and search medical records.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the medical record was added to the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the medical record was last updated in the system.

Insight.title: Insight
Insight.description: Stores AI-powered insights and personalized recommendations generated from patient medical data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Insight entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this insight is for. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Insight)

generatedDate.description: The date and time when the insight was generated.

title.description: A concise title summarizing the insight.

content.description: The detailed explanation or reasoning behind the AI-generated insight.

riskCategory.description: The categorized risk level associated with the insight (e.g., 'Low', 'Medium', 'High', 'Critical').

recommendations.description: A list of actionable recommendations based on the insight.

relatedMedicalRecordIds.description: References to MedicalRecords that contributed to generating this insight. (Relationship: MedicalRecord N:N Insight)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the insight was recorded in the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the insight was last updated (e.g., if re-evaluated).

Specialist.title: Specialist
Specialist.description: Information about a healthcare specialist, used for care navigation and referrals.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Specialist entity.

specialty.description: The medical specialty of the provider (e.g., 'Cardiologist', 'Dermatologist').

organization.description: The organization or clinic the specialist is affiliated with.

address.description: The physical address of the specialist's practice or clinic.

website.description: Optional website URL for the specialist or their practice.

description.description: A brief description of the specialist, their focus, or qualifications.

avgRating.description: The average rating of the specialist, typically on a scale (e.g., 1-5).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the specialist's information was added to the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the specialist's information was last updated.

Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: Stores details about a patient's medical appointments with healthcare providers.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Appointment entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile attending this appointment. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Appointment)

specialistId.description: Reference to the Specialist for this appointment. (Relationship: Specialist 1:N Appointment)

appointmentDateTime.description: The scheduled date and time of the appointment.

status.description: The current status of the appointment (e.g., 'Scheduled', 'Confirmed', 'Completed', 'Cancelled', 'Rescheduled').

notes.description: Any additional notes or instructions for the appointment.

location.description: The physical or virtual location of the appointment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the appointment was created in the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the appointment details were last updated.

Referral.title: Referral
Referral.description: Manages referrals for a patient to see a specialist or receive specific care.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Referral entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile for whom this referral is made. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Referral)

referringProviderId.description: Reference to the CareProvider or Specialist who issued the referral. (Relationship: CareProvider/Specialist 1:N Referral)

referredToSpecialistId.description: Reference to the Specialist to whom the patient is being referred. (Relationship: Specialist 1:N Referral)

referralDate.description: The date when the referral was issued.

reason.description: The medical reason or purpose for the referral.

status.description: The current status of the referral (e.g., 'Pending', 'Approved', 'Denied', 'Completed', 'Expired').

notes.description: Additional notes or context regarding the referral.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the referral was created in the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the referral details were last updated.

HealthGoal.title: HealthGoal
HealthGoal.description: Tracks a patient's personal health goals and monitors their progress towards healthier behaviors.

id.description: Unique identifier for the HealthGoal entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who owns this health goal. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N HealthGoal)

goalType.description: The category of the health goal (e.g., 'Weight Management', 'Exercise', 'Medication Adherence', 'Sleep Improvement').

description.description: A detailed description of the health goal.

startDate.description: The date when the health goal was started.

targetDate.description: The target date for achieving the health goal.

currentProgress.description: The current value representing the user's progress towards the goal (e.g., steps taken, weight lost).

targetValue.description: The target value to be achieved for the goal (e.g., target weight, target steps).

unitOfMeasure.description: The unit of measurement for the goal's progress and target (e.g., 'kg', 'lbs', 'steps', '%').

status.description: The current status of the health goal (e.g., 'Active', 'Completed', 'Paused', 'Abandoned').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the health goal was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the health goal was last updated.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Stores notifications to be delivered to the user for reminders, progress updates, or alerts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Notification entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who should receive this notification. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Notification)

message.description: The content of the notification message.

sentDateTime.description: The date and time when the notification was sent.

isRead.description: Indicates whether the user has read the notification.

actionUri.description: Optional URI for a deep link within the app, related to the notification.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the notification was created in the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the notification was last updated (e.g., read status changed).

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: Represents a secure communication thread between a patient, family members, and/or healthcare providers.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Conversation entity.

participantIds.description: References to the IDs of all participants in this conversation (can be UserProfile, FamilyMember, or CareProvider IDs).

subject.description: The subject or topic of the conversation.

lastMessageDateTime.description: The date and time of the last message sent in this conversation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the conversation was initiated.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the conversation was last updated (e.g., a new message was added).

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents an individual message within a secure communication conversation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Message entity.

conversationId.description: Reference to the Conversation this message belongs to. (Relationship: Conversation 1:N Message)

senderId.description: Reference to the ID of the participant who sent this message (UserProfile, FamilyMember, or CareProvider ID).

messageContent.description: The actual text content of the message.

sentDateTime.description: The date and time when the message was sent.

readByParticipantIds.description: An array of participant IDs who have read this message. (Relationship: Participant N:N Message)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the message was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the message was last updated (e.g., edited, if supported).

FamilyMember.title: FamilyMember
FamilyMember.description: Represents a family member associated with a primary patient for coordinated care and communication.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FamilyMember entity.

patientUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile (patient) this family member is associated with. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N FamilyMember)

relationshipType.description: The relationship of the family member to the patient (e.g., 'Spouse', 'Child', 'Parent', 'Sibling').

contactEmail.description: The family member's contact email address.

contactPhone.description: The family member's contact phone number.

canViewPatientRecords.description: Indicates if this family member has permission to view the patient's medical records.

canMessagePatient.description: Indicates if this family member has permission to communicate with the patient through the app.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the family member record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the family member record was last updated.

CareProvider.title: CareProvider
CareProvider.description: Represents any healthcare provider (e.g., doctor, nurse, therapist) involved in a patient's care.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CareProvider entity.

profession.description: The professional role of the care provider (e.g., 'General Practitioner', 'Nurse', 'Therapist', 'Specialist').

organization.description: The organization or clinic the care provider is affiliated with.

contactEmail.description: The care provider's contact email address.

contactPhone.description: The care provider's contact phone number.

patientUserIds.description: References to the UserProfiles (patients) this care provider is caring for. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N CareProvider)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the care provider's information was added to the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the care provider's information was last updated.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore data structure adheres to the core design principles by prioritizing Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and Access Modeling. All user-specific data is organized under a top-level `users/{userId}` collection, leveraging path-based ownership for simple and robust security rules.

**Authorization Independence:**
Critical to this design is the denormalization of authorization context. For all subcollections (`medicalRecords`, `insights`, `appointments`, `referrals`, `healthGoals`, `notifications`, `familyMembers`), the `userId` (or `patientUserId` for `familyMembers`) is explicitly included in the document's data. This allows security rules to evaluate access by comparing `request.auth.uid` to the `userId` in the path and/or the `userId` field within the `resource.data` document, without needing to perform `get()` calls to parent documents. This ensures atomic operations and simplifies rule debugging. For instance, a `MedicalRecord` document will contain `userId: '...'`, matching `users/{userId}/medicalRecords/{medicalRecordId}`, preventing hierarchical authorization dependencies.

For collaborative entities like `Conversation` and `Message`, the `participantIds` array is denormalized within the `Conversation` document. Crucially, to strictly adhere to the mandate of avoiding `get()` calls for subcollections that depend on parent attributes, the `participantIds` array from the parent `Conversation` *must also be denormalized into each `Message` document*. This allows security rules for `Message` documents to be evaluated independently by checking `request.auth.uid in resource.data.participantIds` rather than `get()`ing the parent `Conversation`.

`CareProvider` documents also contain a `patientUserIds` array, allowing direct membership checks without `get()` calls.

**QAPs (Queryable Authorization Patterns):**
1.  **User-Owned Subcollections:** For paths like `users/{userId}/medicalRecords/{medicalRecordId}`, `list` operations are inherently secure. A client can only query their own data (e.g., `db.collection('users').doc(auth.uid).collection('medicalRecords')`), and security rules can easily enforce `allow list: if request.auth.uid == userId;`. The path itself acts as the filter, fulfilling the QAP.
2.  **Collaborative Data (`conversations`):** Users can query for conversations they are a part of by using `db.collection('conversations').where('participantIds', 'array-contains', request.auth.uid)`. This query is directly supported by Firestore indices and allows security rules to permit `list` operations only when `request.auth.uid` is present in the `participantIds` array within the query's filter, thereby maintaining QAP compliance.
3.  **Shared Resources (`careProviders`):** Similarly, to find their associated care providers, a user can query `db.collection('careProviders').where('patientUserIds', 'array-contains', request.auth.uid)`. This also adheres to QAP, allowing efficient and secure listing of relevant providers.

**Structural Segregation and Access Modeling:**
*   `UserProfile` and all its `1:N` related entities (`MedicalRecord`, `Insight`, `Appointment`, `Referral`, `HealthGoal`, `Notification`, `FamilyMember`) are housed under `users/{userId}`. This ensures that personal data is strictly isolated and accessible only by the owning user (or authorized family members/care providers via explicit permissions or shared conversations, which are handled via membership maps).
*   `Specialist` entities are placed in a top-level collection `specialists/{specialistId}`. This collection represents a global directory, likely read-only for all authenticated users and managed by administrators, thus having a homogeneous security posture.
*   `CareProvider` entities are also in a top-level collection `careProviders/{careProviderId}`. This global collection facilitates N:N relationships with `UserProfile`s via the `patientUserIds` array, allowing users to discover and manage their linked providers while maintaining data integrity and segregation.
*   `Conversation` and `Message` entities are structured to support secure multi-party communication using denormalized `participantIds` for authorization.
